messages.author: d097239898b13d0a
messages.subject: Segregating sites in Poppr?
parts:
Hi All,

Does poppr have the ability to find the number of segregating sites between two groups? If not, can someone recommend to me a good tool to do this in R from data that has already been read into R for analysis with Poppr?

Thanks,

Karl

messages.author: d097239898b13d0a
messages.subject: Re: Segregating sites in Poppr?
parts: Looks like seg.sites() from pegas will give the segregating sites in a DNA sample.

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Re: Segregating sites in Poppr?
parts:
Hi Karl,

This is correct. Though, seg.sites() is a function from ape.

That being said, you need to convert your data to a DNAbin object. If you have your data coming in from a VCF file, the vcfR package has the vcf2DNAbin() function. If your data are in a FASTA file, then you can use ape's read.fasta().

Hope that helps,
Zhian
